description: This is a Python script for generating configuration JSON files based on input parameters, command-line arguments, and external configuration modules. It includes functions for loading modules, reading config parameters, and handling command-line inputs to produce a structured JSON output.

methods.name: file_name
methods.description: Extracts the base filename without extension from a given path.

methods.name: load_module
methods.description: Loads a Python module from a specified file path using importlib machinery.

methods.name: prepend_file
methods.description: Prepends a line to the beginning of a specified file.

methods.name: get_config_params
methods.description: Reads and returns all lines from a configuration file.

methods.name: check_assignment
methods.description: Checks if a variable is assigned within a file by searching for it inside parentheses.
